title: Geyser Mineral Cone Fountain, 1920s Wyoming Sepia Snapshot
description: A 1920s sepia snapshot capturing tourists visiting a large mineral spring travertine cone formation, similar to the iconic Tepee Fountain in Thermopolis, Wyoming. Water flows over the massive mineral cone against a backdrop of arid western hills, illustrating early 20th-century road trips and American domestic tourism in the American West.
